title: チームミーティング
lines: OK, let's get started. The main thing today is the website launch.
We're a little behind schedule. The design team needs another week.
Is that going to push back the launch date?
Not necessarily. We could start testing the parts that are already finished.
That would save us a few days, actually.
Good idea. Let's plan to launch on the 20th as long as nothing else goes wrong.

questions.explain: The main thing today is the website launch.

questions.q: 公開日についての結論は？
choices: 完成部分からテストを始め、20日公開を目指す
デザインチームを増員する
questions.explain: 完成した部分のテストを先に始め、the 20th を目指すことになりました。

title: 睡眠についてのポッドキャスト
lines: Most adults need between 7 and 9 hours of sleep a night, but many of us get far less.
One common mistake is looking at your phone right before bed.
The light from the screen tells your brain that it's still daytime.
Another tip is to go to bed at the same time every night, even on weekends.
It sounds simple, but it can make a big difference in how you feel.

questions.q: 寝る前にスマホを見るのがよくない理由は？
choices: 画面の光が脳にまだ昼だと伝えるから
questions.explain: The light from the screen tells your brain that it's still daytime.

questions.q: もう1つのアドバイスは？
questions.explain: go to bed at the same time every night, even on weekends

title: 部屋の内見
lines: So this is the living room. It gets a lot of sunlight in the afternoon.
It's bigger than I expected. How much is the rent?
It's 1,200 a month, and that includes water and heating.
Those are separate. You'd need to set them up yourself.
And is the building OK with pets? I've got a cat.
Cats are fine, but you'd have to pay a small deposit.

questions.q: 家賃に含まれているものは？
猫を飼う場合の条件は？

title: カスタマーサポート
lines: Thanks for calling. What can I do for you today?
I ordered a printer last week, but it arrived with a cracked screen.
I'm really sorry to hear that. Could I have your order number?
Thanks. I can either send you a replacement or give you a full refund.
I'd prefer a replacement, as long as it arrives before the weekend.
It'll be there by Thursday at the latest.

choices: プリンターが届かない
questions.explain: it arrived with a cracked screen

title: 旅先でのハプニング
lines: A couple of years ago, I went backpacking in Portugal with a friend.
On the third day, we missed the last bus back to our hostel.
We didn't know what to do, and our phones were almost dead.
Then an old man who ran a small bakery offered to drive us.
He wouldn't take any money, so we bought a whole bag of his bread instead.

choices: 最終バスに乗り遅れた

questions.q: パンを1袋買った理由は？
choices: お腹が空いていたから
男性がお金を受け取らなかったのでお礼として
questions.explain: He wouldn't take any money, so ... instead → お礼の代わり。

title: 料理教室
lines: First, cut the onions and the garlic into small pieces.
Heat some oil in a large pan, and cook the onions until they turn soft.
Add the tomatoes and a pinch of salt, then let it simmer for about 15 minutes.
While that's cooking, boil the pasta in plenty of salted water.
Finally, mix everything together and add some fresh basil on top.

questions.q: トマトを加えた後に煮込む時間は？

questions.explain: add some fresh basil on top

title: 大学の講義の導入
lines: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to Introduction to Psychology.
Before we begin, a few quick notes about the course.
There'll be 2 short essays and a final exam, which counts for half of your grade.
All the readings are available online, so you don't need to buy a textbook.
Today, we're going to look at a simple question: why do we forget things?

title: フライト遅延

Here's a meal voucher as well, since you'll have to wait a while.

lines: Hey, did you end up going to that new ramen place?
